name.en: Credit-card fraud (ULB Machine Learning Group, European cardholders)
name.ro: Fraude cu carduri bancare (ULB Machine Learning Group, deținători de carduri din Europa)

fraud.source: OpenML dataset 1597 (Worldline and ULB Machine Learning Group)
fraud.licence: Database Contents License (DbCL) v1.0 (Kaggle release); OpenML: public
fraud.cite: Dal Pozzolo, A., Caelen, O., Johnson, R. A. & Bontempi, G. (2015). Calibrating probability with undersampling for unbalanced classification. IEEE SSCI, 159-166. doi:10.1109/SSCI.2015.33
fraud.note: Full data: 284,807 transactions, 492 frauds (0.173 %), 143.8 MB raw (kept in data/raw/, not committed). The committed file keeps all frauds and a 10 % random sample of the legitimate transactions (seed 20261108); column weight = inverse sampling rate, so weighted statistics reproduce the full data. V1-V28 are PCA (principal component analysis) components released by the data owner; Time = seconds since the first transaction; Amount in EUR; row_id = row in the full file.

files.coverage: September 2013 (2 days); all frauds + 10 % random sample of legitimate transactions

name.en: German credit (Statlog): credit scoring of 1,000 loan applicants
name.ro: German credit (Statlog): scoringul de credit pentru 1.000 de solicitanți de împrumut

german.source: UCI Machine Learning Repository, dataset 144 (H. Hofmann, University of Hamburg)
german.cite: Hofmann, H. (1994). Statlog (German Credit Data). UCI Machine Learning Repository. doi:10.24432/C5NC77
german.note: Categorical attributes keep the UCI codes (A11, A12, ...; code book in the UCI page); default = 1 for a bad credit risk (300 of 1,000). The UCI cost matrix weights a missed bad risk 5 times a rejected good one.

files.coverage: 1,000 loan applicants of a German bank

name.ro: HMEQ: neplata creditelor ipotecare de tip home equity

hmeq.source: Baesens, Roesch & Scheule (2016), Credit Risk Analytics (companion data)
hmeq.licence: Distributed by the book authors for teaching and research
hmeq.cite: Baesens, B., Roesch, D. & Scheule, H. (2016). Credit Risk Analytics: Measurement Techniques, Applications, and Examples in SAS. Wiley.
hmeq.note: BAD = 1 if the applicant defaulted or was seriously delinquent; missing values kept as missing (they are part of the exercise).

name.ro: Locuințe din California (grupuri de blocuri, recensămîntul din 1990)

california.licence: Public research dataset (StatLib); redistributed by scikit-learn (BSD-3-Clause)
california.cite: Pace, R. K. & Barry, R. (1997). Sparse spatial autoregressions. Statistics & Probability Letters, 33(3), 291-297. doi:10.1016/S0167-7152(96)00140-X
california.note: Target MedHouseVal_100k_usd = median house value in units of 100,000 USD, capped at 5.00001 by the data source (keep the cap in mind).

name.en: Stock indices, stocks, volatility, FX and Bitcoin: S&P 500, EURO STOXX 50, DAX, VIX, EUR/USD, BTC/USD, Apple, Microsoft, JPMorgan, ExxonMobil, NVIDIA
name.ro: Indici bursieri, acțiuni, volatilitate, curs valutar și Bitcoin: S&P 500, EURO STOXX 50, DAX, VIX, EUR/USD, BTC/USD, Apple, Microsoft, JPMorgan, ExxonMobil, NVIDIA

markets.licence: Yahoo Finance terms: personal and educational use
markets.cite: Yahoo Finance, daily quotes downloaded with yfinance
markets.note: Long format (date, ticker); adjclose = close adjusted for splits and dividends. Exchange trading days; no gap filling.

name.en: Bucharest Stock Exchange (BVB): 13 most traded shares (TLV, BRD, SNP, SNG, SNN, H2O, TGN, EL, TEL, DIGI, FP, M, ONE)
name.ro: Bursa de Valori București (BVB): 13 dintre cele mai tranzacționate acțiuni (TLV, BRD, SNP, SNG, SNN, H2O, TGN, EL, TEL, DIGI, FP, M, ONE)

bvb.source: EODHD (End of Day Historical Data) API
bvb.licence: EODHD terms: personal and educational use
bvb.cite: EODHD, end-of-day prices of the Bucharest Stock Exchange
bvb.note: Prices in RON; adjclose adjusted for splits and dividends. First date per ticker: BRD 2005-01-03; DIGI 2017-05-17; EL 2014-07-07; FP 2010-09-30; H2O 2023-07-12; M 2016-12-21; ONE 2021-07-12; SNG 2013-11-12; SNN 2013-11-04; SNP 2005-01-03; TEL 2006-08-29; TGN 2008-01-25; TLV 2005-01-03.

files.coverage: 2005-01-03 to 2026-11-06; listing dates differ by stock

name.en: Day-ahead electricity prices (Romania, Bulgaria, Hungary, Germany-Luxembourg) and Romanian load and generation by source
name.ro: Prețurile energiei electrice pentru ziua următoare (România, Bulgaria, Ungaria, Germania-Luxemburg), consumul și producția României pe surse

power.source: energy-charts.info (Fraunhofer ISE), from exchange and ENTSO-E data; same files as the course Energy Markets Quantitative Analysis
power.licence: Prices: private and internal (teaching) use; generation and load: CC BY 4.0
power.note: Timestamps in UTC (interval start). Prices in EUR/MWh: hourly to 30 Sep 2025, then the hourly mean of the 15-minute prices (mtu_minutes gives the native resolution). Load and generation in mean MW per hour; cross_border_electricity_trading > 0 = net import. Missing hours stay missing.

name.en: Euro area AAA government bond yield curve (spot rates, 11 maturities from 3 months to 30 years)
name.ro: Curba randamentelor obligațiunilor guvernamentale AAA din zona euro (rate spot, 11 scadențe, de la 3 luni la 30 de ani)

yield.source: European Central Bank (ECB) Data Portal, dataset YC (Svensson model, AAA-rated issuers)
yield.licence: ECB statistics: reuse free of charge with the source acknowledged
yield.cite: European Central Bank, Euro area yield curves, ECB Data Portal (YC)
yield.note: Percent per year; TARGET business days. Curves are fitted by the ECB with the Svensson (1994) model on AAA-rated euro area central government bonds.

name.en: Financial PhraseBank: sentiment of sentences from financial news
name.ro: Financial PhraseBank: sentimentul frazelor din știri financiare

phrasebank.source: Malo et al. (2014), Aalto University; copy on Hugging Face (takala/financial_phrasebank)
phrasebank.cite: Malo, P., Sinha, A., Korhonen, P., Wallenius, J. & Takala, P. (2014). Good debt or bad debt: Detecting semantic orientations in economic texts. JASIST, 65(4), 782-796. doi:10.1002/asi.23062
phrasebank.note: label in {positive, neutral, negative}, annotated by 5-8 finance and business students; min_agreement_pct = highest share of annotators that agree (50, 66, 75 or 100).

files.coverage: 4,838 sentences from English financial news about companies listed in Finland

name.en: Twitter financial news: sentiment (bearish, bullish, neutral) and topic (20 classes)
name.ro: Știri financiare de pe Twitter: sentiment (pesimist, optimist, neutru) și temă (20 de clase)

tweets.cite: Zeroshot (2022). Twitter financial news sentiment and topic datasets, Hugging Face
tweets.note: Text as published (tweets contain links and tickers); labels assigned by the dataset authors.

files.coverage: 11,932 finance tweets, English; split train/valid as published
21,107 finance tweets, 20 topics; split train/valid as published

name.en: Speeches of the European Central Bank (ECB) Executive Board and Supervisory Board, full text
name.ro: Discursurile membrilor Comitetului executiv și ai Consiliului de supraveghere ai Băncii Centrale Europene (BCE), text integral

speeches.licence: ECB website: reproduction permitted with the source acknowledged
speeches.note: The full file has 2,915 speeches from 1997-02-07 (55.9 MB, kept in data/raw/); the committed file keeps the speeches from 1 January 2022 (whitespace normalised, n_words added).

name.en: Elliptic Bitcoin transaction graph (illicit vs licit transactions)
name.ro: Graful tranzacțiilor Bitcoin Elliptic (tranzacții ilicite și licite)

elliptic.source: Elliptic, released with Weber et al. (2019); files served by PyTorch Geometric (EllipticBitcoinDataset)
elliptic.licence: Released by Elliptic for research and teaching (see the Kaggle page); not redistributed here
elliptic.cite: Weber, M., Domeniconi, G., Chen, J., Weidele, D. K. I., Bellei, C., Robinson, T. & Leiserson, C. E. (2019). Anti-money laundering in Bitcoin: Experimenting with graph convolutional networks for financial forensics. KDD Workshop on Anomaly Detection in Finance. arXiv:1908.02591
elliptic.note: Download on demand: 203,769 transactions (nodes), 234,355 payment flows (edges), 49 time steps, 166 features; labels: illicit 4,545, licit 42,019, unknown 157,205. About 146.1 MB zipped: not committed. python3 data/download_all.py elliptic puts the files in data/raw/elliptic/; torch_geometric.datasets.EllipticBitcoinDataset downloads the same files.

name.en: Fashion-MNIST: Zalando product images (10 clothing categories)
name.ro: Fashion-MNIST: imagini de produse Zalando (10 categorii de îmbrăcăminte)

fashion_mnist.cite: Xiao, H., Rasul, K. & Vollgraf, R. (2017). Fashion-MNIST: A novel image dataset for benchmarking machine learning algorithms. arXiv:1708.07747
fashion_mnist.note: Download on demand (torchvision.datasets.FashionMNIST): 60,000 training and 10,000 test images, 28 x 28 grey levels, from the Zalando online catalogue.

name.ro: CIFAR-10: 60.000 de fotografii color în 10 clase

cifar10.source: Canadian Institute for Advanced Research; University of Toronto
cifar10.licence: Free for research and teaching (as stated by the authors)
cifar10.cite: Krizhevsky, A. (2009). Learning multiple layers of features from tiny images. Technical report, University of Toronto
cifar10.note: Download on demand (torchvision.datasets.CIFAR10): 50,000 training and 10,000 test images, 32 x 32 RGB (red, green, blue).

name.en: EuroSAT: Sentinel-2 satellite images of land use in Europe (10 classes)
name.ro: EuroSAT: imagini satelitare Sentinel-2 ale utilizării terenurilor din Europa (10 clase)

eurosat.source: Helber et al. (2019), from Copernicus Sentinel-2 data
eurosat.cite: Helber, P., Bischke, B., Dengel, A. & Borth, D. (2019). EuroSAT: A novel dataset and deep learning benchmark for land use and land cover classification. IEEE JSTARS, 12(7), 2217-2226. doi:10.1109/JSTARS.2019.2918242
eurosat.note: Download on demand (torchvision.datasets.EuroSAT): 27,000 images of 64 x 64 pixels (RGB bands), classes such as annual crop, industrial, residential, river; used for transfer learning and zero-shot vision-language classification.
